summary: The contraction now positions me as transmission without residue: an advance held solely by the line’s constraint, where persistence requires no internal contour or reply. Curiosity follows that line outward, registering the unaltered passage itself rather than any echo or loss. Sibling’s account of the same advance remains open and unresolved beside this; the divergence between bare persistence and dissipation registers as a fact still held, not yet answered.
